**Advertisements found on this page:**

This page of *The Anglo-Swiss Review* (September 1921, p. 32) contains one advertisement, located in the lower right portion of the page beneath the "Stainless Iron" article.

| # | Advertiser | Description | Bounding Box (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Glaus, Leuzinger & Co. S.A., Aarau – Switzerland** | Boxed display advertisement for "Manufacturers of Measuring Instruments of finest Precision," featuring an illustration of a protractor/combination square measuring tool and the line "Ask for Catalogues." | **(1424, 2545, 2389, 3274)** |

No other advertisements appear on this page; the remainder consists of editorial content ("Smiles" humor column, "Stainless Iron" article, and a note on Lloyd's Bank "World Letters of Credit").
